stageNotes: Stage 1: apex gotenda.com 307-redirects to https://www.gotenda.com/ inside Playwright; www is canonical.

Stage 2: Sucuri active JS-cookie challenge on every direct curl (8/8 batches return 307). Cookie name rotates per probe. recaptcha-v3 script present site-wide but does not gate the catalog crawl path - hasCaptcha=false. No age-gate.
Stage 3: WooCommerce confirmed - WordPress 6.7.1 generator meta + /wp-json/wc/store/v1 returns JSON.

Stage 4: 15 top-level categories (10 firearm-relevant). Single /shop/?orderby=date covers all 16,615 products. Did NOT run full per-category walk-and-dedup due to 20-min budget. Extraction-quality spot-check (3 products) PASSED.
Stage 5: zero-overlap test passed. ?paged=2 returns 27 slugs vs page-1's 29 with only 5 overlap (featured-products repetition). /page/2/ returns identical set to ?paged=2.
Stage 6: 3-outcome. default == date (honored-default-is-newest), default != price. Sort honored. sortParam=?orderby=date.
Stage 7: WC WP REST modified_after two-probe passed. api-date-since-watermark.
Stage 8: wp-rest-header via /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=1 -> x-wp-total=16615. Cross-confirmed vs WP REST core.
